{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
df_filtered = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Calculate the total number of such customers and the number who converted
total_new_paid_search = len(df_filtered)
converted_new_paid_search = df_filtered['converted'].sum()

# Compute the fraction converted
fraction_converted = converted_new_paid_search / total_new_paid_search

# Print all required values
print(f'total_new_paid_search = {total_new_paid_search}')
print(f'converted_new_paid_search = {converted_new_paid_search}')
print(f'fraction_converted = {fraction_converted}')"}
